checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: A water bottle is the main subject and is fully visible
must.why: Whole bottle is centered, with cap and base in frame.
Finish is flat black with only a faint soft sheen, no glossy glare.
White marble with grey veins is visible in the foreground and under the bottle.
Light is diffused and the shadow is soft and light.

faults.what: Marble occupies only the bottom quarter of the frame, so it is less prominent. The bottle design is slightly generic and the resolution is low (640px).

summary: A clean square product shot of a matte black bottle on veined white marble in soft light, meeting all requirements with only minor weaknesses such as low resolution and little marble visible.
